profile.headline: Robotics Software Engineer at Georgia Tech Research Institute

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Explored research in autonomous, collaborative naval vehicles in communications-constrained environments under the Office of Naval Research’s NEEC Program

positions.title: Graduate Student Advisor, VRX Team Lead
positions.description:
• Developed autonomous underwater vehicles for RoboSub, RoboBoat, and RobotX international competitions using various computer vision, machine learning, and path-planning algorithms
• Advised 25 undergraduate students on design direction and project management tasks
• Led the team to a second place finish in the 2019 Virtual RobotX (VRX) inaugural competition

positions.title: Robotics Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Developed visual tracking algorithm comparing an extended Kalman filter and square-root cubature Kalman filter for vision-based leader-follower formations of unmanned autonomous vehicles
• Contributed to the open source flight software ArduPilot by integrating a new software in the loop simulator
• Tested and fixed time-critical bugs in autonomy software on deployed systems

positions.title: Student Research Assistant
positions.locationName: EOS Space Science Center, Magnetosphere Ionosphere Research Laboratory
positions.description:
•	Work under the supervision of Dr. Marc Lessard on the development and writing of a research proposal for a NASA CubeSat mission
•	Development of a clean, optically dark environment for use in calibrating low-light imagers
•	Analyze ground based magnetometer data

positions.title: Math Center Tutor
positions.description:
•	Tutor for courses including Analysis and Applications of Functions, Finite Mathematics, and various Calculus classes
•	Utilize multiple ways to accommodate student's personal learning style in order to explain concepts
•	Assess student comprehension of subject in order to determine progress over the course of the semester

positions.title: Student Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Work under the supervision of Dr. Martin A. Lee and Dr. Charles W. Smith on their “Theory for the Upstream Structure of Energetic Storm Particle Events, Including Wave Excitation”
•	Predominately independent work, including initial learning of the Fortran programming language
•	Generate code to address complex mathematical integration involved in utilizing the data from NASA’s Advanced Composition Explorer

positions.title: Cooperative Engineering Assistant
positions.description:
• Collaborated with industry professionals on research and development projects that required individual initiative for successful completion of deliverables and deadlines
• Engineered and tested an optical system, including a transceiver and laser-aiming reticle for quadrotor payload control
• Designed and documented a testing procedure of a micrometer-accurate latching mechanism

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
•	Processed sales quickly, accurately and efficiently
•	Improved customer service scores through effective handling of customer requests and comments
•	Trained new employees for fulfilling the job’s responsibilities
